context: Sho-young learns to play guitar from Ren in the cafe.
purpose: Adult mentor teaching child music basics.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 蓮にいちゃん、ギター、教えて!
lines.en: Ren, will you teach me guitar?
lines.style: Bright, open request with natural child energy. Leans forward slightly. Warm admiration in the voice. Not demanding — genuinely asking someone he likes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Okay, first put your finger right here.
lines.style: Quiet, patient instruction. Guides without rushing. Warm steadiness — the kind of voice that makes someone feel safe trying something new.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: So I just… pluck it hard and hold down?
lines.style: Uncertain but genuinely curious. Small hesitation on the first words. Soft questioning lilt at the end. Wants to get it right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、優しく、音、出してみて。
lines.en: Yeah — gently though. Try to make a sound.
lines.style: Warm correction, not criticism. Slight emphasis on 'gently' — guiding, not lecturing. Encouraging lean in his voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I made a sound! It sounds like a marble!
lines.style: Pure delight breaks through. Eyes bright. The discovery-moment of a child who's just done something right for the first time. Small gasp of excitement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: That's it — repetition's the thing that matters.
lines.style: Quiet wisdom. Speaks from small experience. Not performing knowledge. Steady, matter-of-fact, but genuinely believing in what he's saying.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 毎日、曲、弾けるように頑張る!
lines.en: I'm going to practice every day so I can play songs!
lines.style: Determination wrapped in warmth. Earnest commitment — a child setting a real goal. Slight breathiness at the end. Not shouting, but resolute.
